query: Broadcom fiscal year end date and fiscal quarter dates
normalized: broadcom date dates end fiscal quarter year

output.content:
Broadcom operates on a 52- or 53-week fiscal year ending on the **Sunday closest to October 31**; it labels each fiscal year by the calendar year in which it ends. [[1]] 

For **fiscal 2025** (a 52-week year), the fiscal year ended **November 2, 2025**, and the quarter-end dates were: [[1]] [[2]]

| Fiscal quarter | End date |
|---|---|
| Q1 FY2025 | February 2, 2025 |
| Q2 FY2025 | May 4, 2025 |
| Q3 FY2025 | August 3, 2025 |
| Q4 FY2025 / fiscal year-end | November 2, 2025 |

Q1 and Q2 FY2025 ended February 2 and May 4, respectively, while Broadcom’s guidance identified August 3, 2025 as the Q3 end date and its FY2025 results identify November 2, 2025 as the Q4/year-end date. [[3]] [[2]] 

Because the company uses a 52/53-week calendar, the precise Sunday dates shift slightly from year to year rather than falling on fixed calendar dates. [[1]]
